items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: At 17:00 EST: floor = max(balance, equity) − 3% of initial balance. ⚠️ Soft breach only — does NOT terminate account. You may resume trading the next day.

items.label: Max Drawdown
items.detail: Trails from highest closing trade balance. Locks at starting balance once 5% profit is reached. After lock → $100 buffer added. Includes closed PnL, swaps, commissions.

items.label: Guardian Shield
items.detail: When combined open floating loss reaches 1% of initial balance, all trades are auto-closed. Soft breach: 1st → split drops to 50%. 2nd → account terminated.

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: No single day's profit may equal or exceed 20% of total payout-period profits. Must keep trading until ratio drops — does not breach account.

items.label: Inactivity
items.detail: At least one trade per 7-day period. Contact support before extended breaks.

items.label: Trading Hours
items.detail: All open trades auto-close at 16:10 EST. Not a breach.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: No open/close/pending orders within 5 min before or after Red Folder releases. 2-min buffer for all news.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: No restriction.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: No restriction.

items.label: Martingale
items.detail: Permitted within margin/contract limits. Inconsistent sizing to recover losses may trigger review.

items.label: Max R:R Ratio
items.detail: Stop loss must not exceed 5× profit target.

items.label: 2% Price Limit
items.detail: No trading within 2% of CME daily price limits.

items.label: Prohibited
items.detail: Microscalping, full AI/bot automation, collaborative trading, account sharing, delayed data exploitation, CME rule violations.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: First $15,000 total profits = 100%. Beyond = 90% split. Guardian Shield 1st breach reduces split to 50%.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: Eligible every 5 days. Requires 5–10 profitable winning days per cycle (see winning day requirement).

items.label: Winning Days
items.detail: Must achieve 5 winning days with minimum net profit of $100/$200/$300 by account size. Some payout cycles may require 10 winning days — confirm with support.

items.label: Consistency
items.detail: Best single day must not exceed 20% of total payout-period profits. Strictest consistency rule across all BGF Futures plans.

items.label: Payout Minimum
items.detail: Minimum payout request.

items.label: First Payout DD
items.detail: After first payout, max drawdown adjusts to starting balance + $100.

items.label: Processing
items.detail: Mon–Fri before 3PM CST via Riseworks. Delay past 24 hrs → $200 bonus.

items.label: Max Funded Accounts
items.detail: Up to 3 funded accounts at any time. Cannot be reset.

items.label: Guardian Shield
items.detail: 1st breach → profit split 50%. 2nd breach → account permanently terminated.
